notes.title: The first anniversary of the release
notes.notes:
Murder Mystery Paradox: Fifteen Years of Summer celebrated its first anniversary on Monday, December 2, 2024. Thank you very much to everyone who has played the game!

To commemorate this first anniversary, we would like to share with you a commemorative illustration by our development staff!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025889/7ae7ece13c77131b1068f5adb0a5c8d3e8069a64.jpg[/img]

We would also like to thank scenario writer Rin Sato, who worked on the scenario for this work, for his comments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025889/e1a05c6b722418d9fa0d9a06f03fa84500631d0f.png[/img].



Murder Mystery Paradox: Fifteen Years of Summer is currently on sale for the first time at 40% off! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025889/6b5841da3d44acdbf8f06e3cffd89141ab50cecf.jpg[/img].

The sale will last until Thursday, December 5, 2024 at 2:59 p.m. If you haven't played the game yet, this is a great opportunity to enjoy it!

We look forward to your continued support of “Murder Mystery Paradox: Fifteen Years of Summer”!

notes.title: Art book is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44025889/abaa4fea6b26e9d6f419aa33ece9207548d73101.jpg[/img]

A 175-page digital art book containing illustrations of characters and backgrounds from "Murder Mystery Paradox: Fifteen Years of Summer" is now available!
A special bundle version is also available now (also available for those who have already purchased the full version).

You can also purchase the main game at a 30% discount during the Steam Summer SALE 2024, which is currently being held.
Please take this opportunity to enjoy"Murder Mystery Paradox: Fifteen Years of Summer"!

-How to access the art book:
1. Open Steam Library
2. Select "Murder Mystery Paradox: Fifteen Years of Summer"
3. Click the Settings Button (gear icon)
4. Select Manage > Browse local files
5. Open "マーダーミステリーパラドクス このひと夏の十五年 Artbook.pdf"

*This DLC contains spoilers for the main game.
*Please check the store page below for sale information.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2203040/_/

notes.title: Regarding the operation with Steam Deck (as of 12/4)
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "Murder Mystery Paradox: Fifteen Years of Summer".

At this time, this game is not compatible with Steam Deck.
We recommend that you play this game on a PC that meets the system requirements, as there is a possibility of unexpected behavior or unidentified problems after launching the game. We ask for your understanding in advance.
